sources.title: Bharat Seva Guide — How to Apply for Passport Online 2026
sources.text:
Processing Time: 7-15 days Fee: ₹1,500 - ₹3,500 Updated: February 2026

Documents Required for Passport

Schedule an appointment at your nearest Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) or Regional Passport Office (RPO).

After PSK visit, police verification will be conducted at your residential address.

Tatkal has additional ₹2,000.

sources.title: TripFactory — How to Apply for a Passport in India (Online Guide 2026)
sources.text:
This is the only valid portal through which you can apply for an Indian passport online.

Fees (Standard): ₹1,500 for 36 pages (Normal), ₹2,000 for 60 pages (Normal).

Processing Time: 7–14 working days (Normal), 1–3 days (Tatkal).

Batch of 2024.

## Tatkaal urgent service

The documents required are proof of address and proof of date of birth.

The application fee is Rs 1000.

Police verification is required and involves a visit to your home address.

Processing takes 10 working days.
